predictions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague';

SELECT AVG(monthly_payment) AS average_monthly_payment
FROM loans;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client AS c
JOIN district AS d
  ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 10000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS client_count
FROM disp AS d
JOIN account AS a
  ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district AS di
  ON a.district_id = di.A1
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND di.A3 = 'Prague';

SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM transactions
WHERE account_id = 1
  AND transaction_date >= DATE '1997-01-01'
  AND transaction_date < DATE '1998-01-01';

SELECT
    d.district_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.client_id) AS owner_count
FROM district AS d
JOIN account AS a
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp AS p
    ON p.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.region = 'south Moravia'
  AND p.type = 'OWNER'
GROUP BY
    d.district_id,
    d.district_name
ORDER BY owner_count DESC;

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS d
    ON c.client_id = d.client_id
   AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN account AS a
    ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan AS l
    ON a.account_id = l.account_id
GROUP BY
    c.client_id,
    c.gender
ORDER BY
    total_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS running_good_standing_loans
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a
    ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN disp AS d
    ON d.account_id = a.account_id
   AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client AS c
    ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district AS di
    ON di.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'C'                         -- running and in good standing
  AND di.A3 = 'north Bohemia'
  AND CAST(SUBSTRING(c.birth_number, 3, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 12;  -- male
